text: Implemented deterministic bounded fuzzing for checked scenes, mappings, transforms, breaks, and layout on JVM and Scala.js; transform, custom-break, and text-metric callback exceptions now become typed failures. Added a reviewed 360x240 Java2D golden using PDFBox 3.0.8 Liberation Sans bytes through a fixed font resolver, disabled antialiasing, documented perceptual thresholds, failure artifacts, and an explicit updater. Focused core courts pass on both platforms and all 23 Java2D tests pass.
